notes: Initial call 2026-01-15 w/ infra + security — customer is building an AI infra offering for regulated finance customers.
Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with strict EU data residency for some customers and NA for others; they will host data in customer-specific subnets.

Key security requirements called out: SSO via SAML (Azure AD), SCIM for user/group sync, audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, KMS integration (customer-managed key preferred/HSM), and long retention for logs (365 days).
Quote from security lead: 'We need proof that admin actions are auditable and SCIM can de-provision accounts quickly on offboarding.'
Networking constraints: must allow only egress to specific Redwood control plane IPs (TBD) and prefer VPC peering over public NAT where possible.
Asked about RBAC: wants console roles mapped to SCIM groups (platform-admin, ops, app-dev, billing) and API keys limited to role scope.
Evaluating two rollout options: (A) Private VPC in Redwood managed account with customer-owned KMS, (B) On-premise appliance / air-gapped in future phase for highest-regulated clients.
Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to commit to 12 mo reserved capacity for predictable pricing if SLA and SSO/SCIM are enterprise-grade.
SE notes: will prepare a SAML metadata checklist + SCIM capabilities matrix; need to confirm supported SCIM patch semantics and group membership sync frequency.
Legal: procurement requested standard SOC2 + ISO27001 attestations and a redlineable DPA. Drive doc linked above.
Support risk: customer will require 24x7 oncall for first 90 days of POC; discuss support add-on pricing.
Next scheduled: security review meeting 2026-02-18 (invite sent), infra deep-dive 2026-02-20.
